strong_advisory_escalation_gate.effect: Strong advisory families escalate PASS to PASS_WITH_FIX, then fail-close to REJECT when local fix contract is not ready.

fix_pack_contract.effect: PASS_WITH_FIX requires inplace scope and a ready fix_pack; otherwise it is downgraded.

retry_patch_gate.effect: Missing patch targets and non-ready fix_pack force rewrite and can escalate to TF-4 full rewrite.

post_select_downgrade.effect: Provisional pass is downgraded to REJECT on post-select conflict and stored as previous_attempt with full-scope conflict contract.

reject_snapshot_elision.effect: Post-select conflict snapshots blank fix_pack and may elide rationale, making operator diagnosis harder.

medium_confidence_conclusions: The final post_select_conflict was more likely tied to opening carryover/continuity pressure than to the phone wording itself, because the final selected manuscript explicitly preserves folder-phone and storage-location continuity while Director still logs repeated V66.1 continuity warnings.
The advisory loop is a Stage4 issue and does not contradict the Stage2/3 context-normalization improvements.
